algorithm.name: P256-SHA256
algorithm.private_key: generated and retained on device; never a protocol field

proof.encoding: ASCII, each field followed by LF; UUIDs canonical lowercase with hyphens
proof.reboot_verification: server verifies two signatures with one public key and different boot nonces

storage.policy: append-only, no erase; resume a complete pending record with the same key; reject unknown/corrupt committed data
storage.diagnostics: Read-only failure classification and relative 256-byte slot offset; 8192 means no specific slot. No flash contents, private key, erase or recovery command.
storage.explicit_development_recovery: Separate operator-confirmed initialization only: refuse Ready/Pending/read faults and any recognizable identity across all slots, no active BLE/save, exact hardware/current boot; erase only pages0xed000/0xee000, verify blank and unchanged phone bonds. Never called by normal provisioning, retry, boot or firmware update.

compatibility.numeric_usb_v1: unchanged diagnostics; identity returns unsupported_version when permanent state is populated or not known empty
compatibility.product_role: CORE is explicit; missing attempt role means legacy LINK only. The signed immutable article/revision binding and build are checked against the server product role.
compatibility.core_runtime: USB identity only; no phone connections or advertising.

security_boundary: Internal development USB station and operator-authenticated backend. Explicit legacy identity-page initialization requires a separate confirmed maintenance action; normal provisioning/update/retry never erases. Production Bluetooth authorization, ownership claiming, manufacturer attestation, readout protection and identity/key replacement are not provided.
